description: Five project descriptions manually annotated against all 15 budgets in data/budgets_sample.json before measuring retrieval. Relevance requires matching the requested functionality, not merely sharing a sector. A retrieved chunk is relevant when its parent budget_id is annotated. Evaluation uses only the base corpus. Queries and PostgreSQL full-text configuration are English to match the shipped dataset.

queries.query: Mobile banking application with OAuth2 authentication, PSD2 open banking compliance, strong customer authentication and a transaction ledger.
queries.note: Fintech auth + payments. Trap: BUD-2024-006 (e-commerce marketplace vendor payouts) is 'payments-like' but irrelevant for a banking auth project.

queries.query: Headless e-commerce storefront with a product catalog, shopping cart checkout and personalized product recommendations.
queries.note: BUD-2024-005 directly covers catalog, cart, recommendations and storefront. BUD-2024-006 covers vendor payouts/disputes and BUD-2024-007 delivery slots/routes: same sector, but neither implements the requested storefront. Only four relevant chunks exist, so the maximum chunk precision@5 is 0.8.

queries.query: Telemedicine platform for patient appointment scheduling and video consultations with HL7/FHIR integration and clinical records.
queries.note: BUD-2024-009 directly implements FHIR integration, scheduling and video consultations. BUD-2024-010 covers wearables/alerts, not telemedicine; BUD-2024-011 and BUD-2024-012 cover pharmacy and trials. Only four relevant chunks exist, so the maximum chunk precision@5 is 0.8.

queries.query: Industrial IoT platform ingesting sensor telemetry for predictive maintenance and real-time equipment monitoring in a factory.
queries.note: BUD-2024-013 covers sensor ingestion, predictive maintenance and SCADA integration. BUD-2024-014 covers warehouse logistics; BUD-2024-015 covers energy-grid demand response rather than factory maintenance. Only three relevant chunks exist, so the maximum chunk precision@5 is 0.6.

queries.query: Real-time payments gateway with fraud detection, transaction reconciliation and a double-entry ledger.
queries.note: Fintech payments. Trap: BUD-2024-006 (e-commerce vendor payouts) and BUD-2024-007 (grocery delivery payments) are lexically near but wrong domain.
